title: 23_Quest_Rewards
main_characters: Go on. Say the magic words.

pick_word.subtitle: Help Brendizzle escape! Run away to win!
Help Brendizzle fight! Attack to win!
Help Brendizzle fight! Attack to win!

question_options.question: How would you rate this pack?
Which player character did you like best?

nodes.speaker: NColddSpud
nodes.text: And my first act as Warchief will be to lead the Highpants Kings on a quest to find the `PryBlade of Perfidius!`
nodes.text_bbcode: And my first act as Warchief will be to lead the Highpants Kings on a quest to find the [color=#e23b3b][i]PryBlade of Perfidius![/i][/color]

nodes.speaker: Elbow Baghands
nodes.text: The PryBlade of Perfidious?! No way!

nodes.speaker: Blue DaNoob
nodes.text: That quest is supposed to be totally epic!

nodes.speaker: Brendizzle
nodes.text: But that... That was my idea!

nodes.speaker: NColddSpud
nodes.text: Yeah, whatever! Mount up, peeps!
As the rest of the clan members begin to mount their steeds, a few wander over to Brendizzle to offer condolences.

nodes.speaker: Elbow Baghands
nodes.text: Look, Brendizzle, it's nothing personal. We always had a great time with you.

nodes.speaker: Blue DaNoob
nodes.text: But you weren't around, and NColddSpud promised to take us on some really cool quests.

nodes.speaker: NColddSpud
nodes.text: Follow me! I know the way!
NColddSpud steers his Evonian Tyger toward Underville...

nodes.speaker: KillerKitten13
nodes.text: Spud! I mean... NColddSpud, turn on your mini-map! You're going the wrong way!

nodes.speaker: Elbow Baghands
nodes.text: Anyway, we better get going. See you!

nodes.speaker: Blue DaNoob
nodes.text: Yeah, see you!
And then... Brendizzle is left alone.

nodes.speaker: Brendizzle
nodes.text: It seems to me that there's only one way to settle who should be Warchief. We fight for the privilege!
A banner descends from the sky, signaling that a challenge has been issued...
NColddSpud denies the request for a duel. The flag disappears in a poof of smoke!

nodes.speaker: NColddSpud
nodes.text: You think I'd waste time fighting you? Why?

nodes.speaker: NColddSpud
nodes.text: We already held elections. The people have spoken. And the 'ayes' have it.

nodes.speaker: NColddSpud
nodes.text: Which means, 'I' have it.
Brendizzle relaxes his grip.

nodes.speaker: Brendizzle
nodes.text: Well, if there's been a vote then there's nothing else that I can do. You've clearly already made up your minds.

nodes.speaker: NColddSpud
nodes.text: That's a relief. For a moment there I almost thought you were going to do something ridiculous like challenge me to a duel.

nodes.speaker: NColddSpud
nodes.text: Those pathetic displays of emotion were one of the reasons Kat chose me over you.

nodes.speaker: NColddSpud
nodes.text: Well, that and this really kickin' raid gear I'm wearing.

nodes.speaker: Brendizzle
nodes.text: Shouldn't you be calling her KillerKitten13 instead of Kat? This is a role-playing clan, remember?

nodes.speaker: Elbow Baghands
nodes.text: Uh... Brendizzle does kind of have a point.

nodes.speaker: NColddSpud
nodes.text: Hey! I'm the Warchief now. The rules don't apply to me. I can do anything I want...

nodes.speaker: Hector
nodes.text: Wow. You've really given this some thought, haven't you?

nodes.speaker: Brendan
nodes.text: Sure have. Now, I've got to get going.

nodes.speaker: Brendan
nodes.text: The clan is logging on in half an hour.

nodes.speaker: Brendan
nodes.text: See ya!
Brendan races into his room.
He powers up his UFO Gear desktop computer and logs in to his Warscrewdriver: Online account.

nodes.speaker: Brendan
nodes.text: Lo! I am Brendan no more...

nodes.speaker: Brendizzle
nodes.text: I arise `Brendizzle`, honored Warchief of the Highpants Kings.
nodes.text_bbcode: I arise [color=#e23b3b][i]Brendizzle[/i][/color], honored Warchief of the Highpants Kings.

nodes.speaker: Brendizzle
nodes.text: Now, to make my way to the Ogre City of Mogrimal.
As Brendizzle approaches the Manuscriptory, he hears the sounds of a raucous celebration coming from inside.

nodes.speaker: Brendizzle
nodes.text: Hey! What's going on in here?

nodes.speaker: Elbow Baghands
nodes.text: Oh... Hey, Brendizzle... What are you doing here?

nodes.speaker: Brendizzle
nodes.text: What do you mean 'What am I doing here?' I'm the Clan Warchief.

nodes.speaker: Brendizzle
nodes.text: The party isn't supposed to start until I perform the ceremonial break dance.

nodes.speaker: NColddSpud
nodes.text: Looks like things have changed, Brendizzle...
A powerful Dwarven Thief steps forward. A nervous hush spreads across the room...

nodes.speaker: NColddSpud
nodes.text: Or should I say, 'Bren-Fizzled-Out'.

nodes.speaker: Brendizzle
nodes.text: Uh... Spud, is that you?

nodes.speaker: NColddSpud
nodes.text: According to the charter, Highpants Kings is a role-playing clan.

nodes.speaker: NColddSpud
nodes.text: Thou shall address me using my character name henceforth, or be reported for the use of anachronistic speech.

nodes.speaker: Brendizzle
nodes.text: Whatever, Spud. Why are you even here? This is a 'clan members only' event.

nodes.speaker: KillerKitten13
nodes.text: Actually, Spud `is` in the clan now.
nodes.text_bbcode: Actually, Spud [color=#3b78e2][i]is[/i][/color] in the clan now.

nodes.speaker: Brendizzle
nodes.text: Kat? When did this happen?

nodes.speaker: KillerKitten13
nodes.text: The clan had a vote last night.

nodes.speaker: Brendizzle
nodes.text: It did? Why wasn't I informed?

nodes.speaker: KillerKitten13
nodes.text: Brendizzle, we tried to tell you, except you haven't been logging on much lately.

nodes.speaker: Brendizzle
nodes.text: Well, fine... I guess I'll allow it.

nodes.speaker: Brendan
nodes.text: Ha! Now when I locate the PryBlade of Perfidius, I'll have two suckers to choose from.

nodes.speaker: NColddSpud
nodes.text: Who cares what you allow?

nodes.speaker: Brendizzle
nodes.text: Who cares? I'm the Clan Warchief! My every word is mandate!

nodes.speaker: NColddSpud
nodes.text: Not anymore, Bren`drizzle!`
nodes.text_bbcode: Not anymore, Bren[color=#e23b3b][i]drizzle![/i][/color]

nodes.speaker: NColddSpud
nodes.text: There was a second vote last night, and I've been elected the new Clan Warchief. Isn't that right, wench?

nodes.speaker: KillerKitten13
nodes.text: I'm sorry, Brendizzle. Like I said, we tried to tell you, but...
Brendizzle feels the blood boil in his veins. He grips the hilt of his sword...

nodes.speaker: Brendan
nodes.text: I can't believe Spud is doing this to me. But if the Clan really voted me out...

nodes.speaker: Brendan
nodes.text: Maybe I should just let this slide. I should...

nodes.speaker: Brendan
nodes.text: Leveling a character takes time and effort... Just like a relationship.

nodes.speaker: Hector
nodes.text: Uh, maybe not 'just' like a relationship.

nodes.speaker: Brendan
nodes.text: Okay, but close enough.

nodes.speaker: Hector
nodes.text: No... Not really.

nodes.speaker: Brendan
nodes.text: My point is, when Kat kissed Spud, she invalidated all the time I'd spent building up experience with her.

nodes.speaker: Brendan
nodes.text: I think it's only fair that she gets a taste of what it's like to lose something she really cares about!

nodes.speaker: Brendan
nodes.text: Kat has no idea what I'm planning. When it comes to blows at Lake Doom, she'll finally understand how deeply she wounded me.

nodes.speaker: Hector
nodes.text: Because you're going to kill her in-game character?

nodes.speaker: Brendan
nodes.text: No! Because when her character, KillerKitten13, dies by my hand, her resurrected spirit will be reduced to Level One.

nodes.speaker: Brendan
nodes.text: She'll practically have to start the game all over. It's a fate worse than death!

rounds.subtitle: Help Brendizzle escape! Run away to win!
Help Brendizzle escape! Run away to win!

nodes.speaker: Brendizzle
nodes.text: You're right! We can chat later. Right now, I need to cover my debt.
Brendizzle accepts the gift of five silver and sprinkles the coins across the bar.

nodes.speaker: Brendizzle
nodes.text: Barmaid! This should cover the cost of my libations.

nodes.speaker: Paladin Monte
nodes.text: Well, I guess you're off the hook for now. But I don't want to see you causing trouble around here ever again!

nodes.speaker: Paladin Monte
nodes.text: And get a job, you no good freeloader!

nodes.speaker: Paladin Monte
nodes.text: And a haircut!

nodes.speaker: Brendizzle
nodes.text: Look, no offense. But I'd really like to know who I'm talking to before I accept this money. Are you Dexter? Howard?

nodes.speaker: Hanid Smythe
nodes.text: Uh... I'm not sure you have time to play guessing games right now.

nodes.speaker: Brendizzle
nodes.text: Hector? Kenji?

nodes.speaker: Hanid Smythe
nodes.text: Uh... Brendizzle...

nodes.speaker: Paladin Monte
nodes.text: Time's up, freeloader!!! You're coming with me!!!

nodes.speaker: Brendizzle
nodes.text: No! Listen, I'll pay... I just...

nodes.speaker: Paladin Monte
nodes.text: You'll pay, all right!
Paladin Monte draws his sword. He slashes at Brendizzle...
Brendizzle ducks the blow!
Paladin Monte's sword sweeps over Brendizzle's head and strikes a nearby Tarusian GraveKnight!

nodes.speaker: Tarusian GraveKnight
nodes.text: `Yowch!!!`
nodes.text_bbcode: [color=#e23b3b][i]Yowch!!![/i][/color]

nodes.speaker: Brendan
nodes.text: Uh oh! This could mean trouble!
The enraged Tarusian GraveKnight lunges at Paladin Monte.
Soon, the entire Firebrand Inn is engulfed in a massive brawl!

nodes.speaker: Hanid Smythe
nodes.text: Brendizzle, quickly! Now's our chance to escape!

nodes.speaker: Brendan
nodes.text: Navigating a brawl requires poise and finesse. I'm going to have to play my best.

nodes.speaker: Hanid Smythe
nodes.text: There's the door! Run!
Brendizzle and Hanid Smythe scramble toward the door, but...
Paladin Monte blocks their escape.

nodes.speaker: Paladin Monte
nodes.text: Now then, you two are coming with me!
Paladin Monte releases his two prisoners outside the gates of Mogrimal.

nodes.speaker: Brendizzle
nodes.text: Hey! Let go! That's mine!

nodes.speaker: Paladin Monte
nodes.text: Not anymore! This Gilded Epaulet should cover what you owe...

nodes.speaker: Paladin Monte
nodes.text: ...But I better not lay eyes on you two deadbeats ever again!

nodes.speaker: Paladin Monte
nodes.text: Not ever!
Paladin Monte crosses away, leaving Brendizzle and Hanid Smythe alone.

nodes.speaker: Brendan
nodes.text: If the chaos in Firebrand Inn didn't convince Hanid Smythe to tell me who he really is, I doubt anything will.

nodes.speaker: Brendan
nodes.text: I guess I'm just going to have to let it go... For now.

nodes.speaker: Brendizzle
nodes.text: I'm sorry I caused you all this trouble, Hanid Smythe. I'm not usually so poor.

nodes.speaker: Hanid Smythe
nodes.text: Don't worry about it. I never really liked Mogrimal anyway.

nodes.speaker: Brendizzle
nodes.text: Yeah...

nodes.speaker: Hanid Smythe
nodes.text: Want to tell me what happened? I'd be happy to listen.

nodes.speaker: Brendizzle
nodes.text: Really? Well, okay...

nodes.speaker: Brendizzle
nodes.text: All my troubles started a few weeks ago...
A few minutes later, Brendizzle slumps into a barstool at the Firebrand Inn.

nodes.speaker: Brendizzle
nodes.text: Barmaid, a flagon of fermented yak's milk to ease my troubled mind.

nodes.speaker: Barmaid
nodes.text: Certainly.
The Barmaid places the frosty mug on the counter...

nodes.speaker: Barmaid
nodes.text: That'll be five silver, if you please.

nodes.speaker: Brendizzle
nodes.text: Five silver? That's no problem, I'll just...

nodes.speaker: Brendan
nodes.text: Oh no! I just realized that without access to the Clan Treasury, I'm completely broke!

nodes.speaker: Brendan
nodes.text: I don't have any money to pay for this drink!

nodes.speaker: Brendizzle
nodes.text: Uh... So Barmaid, I appear to have left my wallet in my other pair of greaves.

nodes.speaker: Barmaid
nodes.text: What's that? Not paying?!

nodes.speaker: Brendizzle
nodes.text: No, I'll pay! I mean, I would pay, but...

nodes.speaker: Barmaid
nodes.text: Security!!!

nodes.speaker: Paladin Monte
nodes.text: What do we have here? A deadbeat?! We have methods for dealing with the likes of you!

nodes.speaker: Paladin Monte
nodes.text: And those methods involve dungeons, torture, and R.O.S.E.S.!

nodes.speaker: Brendizzle
nodes.text: Roses? Why? Because they have sharp thorns and attract venomous snake-bees?

nodes.speaker: Paladin Monte
nodes.text: No! R.O.S.E.S.! It's an acronym. It stands for `Rodents of Super-Extraordinary Size!`
nodes.text_bbcode: No! R.O.S.E.S.! It's an acronym. It stands for [color=#e23b3b][i]Rodents of Super-Extraordinary Size![/i][/color]

nodes.speaker: Paladin Monte
nodes.text: They're way bigger and meaner than the 'unusually-sized' rodents you may have seen elsewhere.

nodes.speaker: Brendizzle
nodes.text: Gulp!
As Paladin Monte moves to escort Brendizzle away, a Trade Window opens...
An elven mage named `Hanid Smythe` offers you a gift of five silver.
nodes.text_bbcode: An elven mage named [b]Hanid Smythe[/b] offers you a gift of five silver.

nodes.speaker: Hanid Smythe
nodes.text: Here. Take this.
At the feet of Hanid Smythe, there is a small, grey kitten...

nodes.speaker: Kitten
nodes.text: Meow!

nodes.speaker: Brendan
nodes.text: `Hanid Smythe?`
nodes.text_bbcode: [color=#e23b3b][i]Hanid Smythe?[/i][/color]

nodes.speaker: Brendan
nodes.text: The name sounds kind of familiar. Do I know anybody who has an avatar with that name?

nodes.speaker: Brendizzle
nodes.text: So, do I know you? Are you a re-roll of someone I've played with before?

nodes.speaker: Hanid Smythe
nodes.text: All your questions will be answered in time, Brendizzle. First, you must accept this gift of five silver and pay your tab.

nodes.speaker: Brendan
nodes.text: Hmm. I'm in a bit of a jam here, but I really don't like taking money from strangers. I should...
A short while later...

nodes.speaker: Kobriak
nodes.text: Harumph! This magical ointment has healed my wounds, but not my pride.

nodes.speaker: Kobriak
nodes.text: I pity the next adventurers foolish enough to cross my path.

nodes.speaker: Kobriak
nodes.text: And, I should add that true wisdom comes from accepting the aide of those who would willingly give it.

nodes.speaker: Kobriak
nodes.text: Anyway, you'll be wanting those directions now. Got a quill and a piece of parchment handy?

nodes.speaker: Kobriak
nodes.text: The turns get a little tricky around Hellzeroth...

nodes.speaker: Kobriak
nodes.text: Well, that's absolutely...

nodes.speaker: Kobriak
nodes.text: ...Correct!

nodes.speaker: Brendan
nodes.text: Looks like stalling didn't work. I should...

options.label: Figure it out on my own.

nodes.speaker: Kobriak
nodes.text: What is your answer?

nodes.speaker: Brendizzle
nodes.text: I've got a small piece of fluff in my ear.

nodes.speaker: Brendizzle
nodes.text: Would you mind repeating that last part about the 'sparrows' meant for my 'cart'?

nodes.speaker: Kobriak
nodes.text: WHAT?! You would ask Kobriak the Outlier to repeat himself?!

nodes.speaker: Brendizzle
nodes.text: Gulp... I... Uh, I guess not.
...And soon, Brendizzle and Hanid Smythe are backed into a corner!

nodes.speaker: Brendizzle
nodes.text: Kobriak's `Wyld Roar Attack` has permanently reduced our maximum hit points!
nodes.text_bbcode: Kobriak's [color=#e23b3b][i]Wyld Roar Attack[/i][/color] has permanently reduced our maximum hit points!

nodes.speaker: Brendizzle
nodes.text: I don't think we can survive another hit!
As Kobriak the Outlier raises his mighty paw to deliver the final blow, Hanid Smyth blurts out...

nodes.speaker: Hanid Smythe
nodes.text: Wait! The answer is a `'true friend'!`
nodes.text_bbcode: Wait! The answer is a [color=#3b78e2][i]'true friend'![/i][/color]

nodes.speaker: Kobriak
nodes.text: Methinks you stall!

nodes.speaker: Brendizzle
nodes.text: No, I'm not stalling... The answer is... Trout!

nodes.speaker: Hanid Smythe
nodes.text: Trout? That doesn't even make any sense.

nodes.speaker: Brendizzle
nodes.text: No. I mean to say trout... Sers! Trousers! Trout trousers!

nodes.speaker: Brendizzle
nodes.text: You know, the pants that fish would wear if fish had legs... Which they don't, so...

nodes.speaker: Hanid Smythe
nodes.text: That makes even less sense!

nodes.speaker: Kobriak
nodes.text: Though you amuse me, mortal, you are also `WRONG!!!` Prepare to be `DEVOURED!!!`
nodes.text_bbcode: Though you amuse me, mortal, you are also [color=#e23b3b][i]WRONG!!![/i][/color] Prepare to be [color=#e23b3b][i]DEVOURED!!![/i][/color]

nodes.speaker: Brendizzle
nodes.text: There's no way out! It looks like we're going to have to fight!

nodes.speaker: Brendan
nodes.text: Kobriak looks really tough. Let's hope I have what it takes to defeat him.
Kobriak the Outlier fights fiercely...
...But Brendizzle and Hanid Smythe prove the mightier warriors!

nodes.speaker: Kobriak
nodes.text: Ow! Uncle! Mercy! Ow!

nodes.speaker: Brendizzle
nodes.text: Hah! Who's smarter than the average bear now?

nodes.speaker: Brendizzle
nodes.text: Tell us where to find the PryBlade of Perfidius or else we'll have to get really rough with you!

nodes.speaker: Kobriak
nodes.text: Okay, you win... I'll tell you what you want to know.

nodes.speaker: Brendizzle
nodes.text: Well, it's just that... You see...

nodes.speaker: Brendizzle
nodes.text: The answer is so insanely obvious that I hesitate even to say it for fear of looking foolish.

nodes.speaker: Brendizzle
nodes.text: Which is to say... The answer is... Um...

nodes.speaker: Brendizzle
nodes.text: Well, any ideas?

nodes.speaker: Hanid Smythe
nodes.text: You're asking me?

nodes.speaker: Brendizzle
nodes.text: Sure, you said you liked the riddle. Did you get what it was about?

nodes.speaker: Hanid Smythe
nodes.text: Actually, I think I did...
Hanid Smythe leans forward and whispers in Brendizzle's ear...

nodes.speaker: Brendizzle
nodes.text: Wow! You're right! And that makes perfect sense!

nodes.speaker: Brendizzle
nodes.text: I definitely wouldn't have figured that out on my own.
Brendizzle turns to the massive Dyre Bear.

nodes.speaker: Brendizzle
nodes.text: The answer is... A `'true friend'.`
nodes.text_bbcode: The answer is... A [color=#e23b3b][i]'true friend'.[/i][/color]

nodes.speaker: Brendizzle
nodes.text: I'd just like a moment to consult with my associate here.

nodes.speaker: Kobriak
nodes.text: Harumph... Well, I suppose that would be acceptable.

nodes.speaker: Kobriak
nodes.text: But make it snappy. If I'm going to be mauling you this evening, I'd like to get a jump on things.

nodes.speaker: Hanid Smythe
nodes.text: So, any idea what Kobriak the Outlier looks like?

nodes.speaker: Kobriak
nodes.text: ROOOOOAAAAARRR!!!

nodes.speaker: Brendizzle
nodes.text: My guess? Big and hairy!

nodes.speaker: Brendizzle
nodes.text: I think that gigantic Dyre Bear lumbering toward us might be him!
The Dyre Bear growls, revealing sharp fangs.

nodes.speaker: Kobriak
nodes.text: Halt, City Dwellers! What business have you in my mire?

nodes.speaker: Brendizzle
nodes.text: Kobriak?

nodes.speaker: Kobriak
nodes.text: That is my name.

nodes.speaker: Hanid Smythe
nodes.text: Go ahead... Ask him already...

nodes.speaker: Brendizzle
nodes.text: Well, we... Err... We seek the legendary PryBlade of Perfidius.

nodes.speaker: Brendizzle
nodes.text: We were told by Gallivax the Mutterer that you might know where it is.

nodes.speaker: Kobriak
nodes.text: Indeed, I do. But a weapon as powerful as the Pryblade should not fall into the hands of one lacking the wisdom to wield it righteously.

nodes.speaker: Kobriak
nodes.text: Prove yourself to me by answering a riddle.

nodes.speaker: Brendizzle
nodes.text: A riddle?

nodes.speaker: Kobriak
nodes.text: Yes. And I advise thee to listen carefully. I shall not repeat myself.
Kobriak thumps his chest to clear his throat.

nodes.speaker: Kobriak
nodes.text: Okay... Ahem... Here goes.

nodes.speaker: Kobriak
nodes.text: 'I was once a stranger, yet I now know the words you do not say...'

nodes.speaker: Kobriak
nodes.text: 'I double joy, divide grief. I wound you deeper than any blade...'

nodes.speaker: Kobriak
nodes.text: 'Yet would gladly take the arrow meant for your heart. What am I?'

nodes.speaker: Hanid Smythe
nodes.text: Wow! That was a great riddle. Dark and angsty, but also lyrical and pretty.

nodes.speaker: Kobriak
nodes.text: Oh, why thank you, Elf.

nodes.speaker: Kobriak
nodes.text: To be honest, there's not much to do out here in the mire, but come up with riddles.

nodes.speaker: Kobriak
nodes.text: I've got bunches, y'know... About all sorts of things...

nodes.speaker: Kobriak
nodes.text: Trees, flowers... There's one I especially like about honey...

nodes.speaker: Kobriak
nodes.text: Mmm... Honey...

nodes.speaker: Kobriak
nodes.text: But enough idle chatter! Answer me now or suffer my wrath!!!

nodes.speaker: Kobriak
nodes.text: ROOOOOAAAAARRR!!!

nodes.speaker: Brendizzle
nodes.text: Right. Well, obviously, the answer is... Uh...

nodes.speaker: Hanid Smythe
nodes.text: Brendizzle, if you need help, I think I know...

nodes.speaker: Brendizzle
nodes.text: No, I've got this.

nodes.speaker: Brendan
nodes.text: Uh oh... I really don't have any idea what the answer is.

nodes.speaker: Brendan
nodes.text: I could ask Hanid Smythe to help me, but the whole point is to prove that `I'm` the best Warchief.
nodes.text_bbcode: I could ask Hanid Smythe to help me, but the whole point is to prove that [color=#e23b3b][i]I'm[/i][/color] the best Warchief.

nodes.speaker: Brendan
nodes.text: Maybe if I heard the riddle one more time...

nodes.speaker: Brendan
nodes.text: I should...

options.label: Figure it out on my own.
Ask Kobriak to repeat the riddle.

nodes.speaker: Hanid Smythe
nodes.text: Just go with it?

nodes.speaker: Brendizzle
nodes.text: Look, if you try to over-analyze a quest, it'll never make any sense.

nodes.speaker: Brendizzle
nodes.text: The important thing is that we follow the instructions precisely.

nodes.speaker: Hanid Smythe
nodes.text: Sounds pretty mindless.

nodes.speaker: Brendizzle
nodes.text: Yeah, tell me about it. When I wanted to forge an elite Juvian Scimitar, I had to farm one hundred golden weevling scales.

nodes.speaker: Brendizzle
nodes.text: By the end, I could barely see straight.

nodes.speaker: Hanid Smythe
nodes.text: That sounds really... Fun?

nodes.speaker: Brendizzle
nodes.text: I know! Totally!

nodes.speaker: Brendizzle
nodes.text: Jonas Carville talked about this in his book `'The Force of Fable.'`
nodes.text_bbcode: Jonas Carville talked about this in his book [color=#e23b3b][i]'The Force of Fable.'[/i][/color]

nodes.speaker: Brendizzle
nodes.text: According to Carville, a true hero must leave home, journey into the unknown, discover knowledge, and then return with it.

nodes.speaker: Hanid Smythe
nodes.text: Really?

nodes.speaker: Brendizzle
nodes.text: Sure. All epic stories follow this pattern, from 'The Illiad' to Jorge Loomis' 'Space Battles'.

nodes.speaker: Hanid Smythe
nodes.text: Wow, Brendizzle. I'm impressed. You really know your stuff.
A short while later...

rounds.subtitle: Help Brendizzle fight! Attack to win!
Help Brendizzle fight! Attack to win!

nodes.text: Snicker snack! Brendizzle and Hanid Smythe slice through the Scorpiax Beetles!
In no time at all, Brendizzle and Hanid Smythe have cleared the beach.

nodes.speaker: Brendizzle
nodes.text: Wow! We really work well together, don't we?
Suddenly... One last Scorpiax Beetle emerges from a hiding place beneath the sand.
The Scorpiax Beetle leaps at Brendizzle!
Hanid Smythe groans in pain.

nodes.speaker: Hanid Smythe
nodes.text: Nnnnhhh...

nodes.speaker: Amanda
nodes.text: So, Brendan... Is your friend going to be all right?

nodes.speaker: Brendan
nodes.text: Hanid Smythe took the sting for me!

nodes.speaker: Brendan
nodes.text: That's going to put him at a big disadvantage if we have to fight each other for the PryBlade.

nodes.speaker: Brendan
nodes.text: Maybe Hanid really doesn't know about the curse.

nodes.speaker: Brendan
nodes.text: But if that were true, I'd be leading him right into a trap!

nodes.speaker: Brendizzle
nodes.text: Hanid Smythe, you're hurt. Maybe we should head back to Mogrimal...

nodes.speaker: Hanid Smythe
nodes.text: No... We're almost to... The Pryblade.

nodes.speaker: Amanda
nodes.text: PryBlade?

nodes.speaker: Brendizzle
nodes.text: We're on a quest to find a legendary weapon of unprecedented power, lost for millennia, concealed by time, and...

nodes.speaker: Amanda
nodes.text: You mean the glowy-swordy thing?

nodes.speaker: Brendizzle
nodes.text: You've seen the Pry... I mean, you've seen a glowy-swordy thing near here?

nodes.speaker: Amanda
nodes.text: Sure! It's right over there!

nodes.speaker: Amanda
nodes.text: Just remember to say 'Amicus Prodo' or you won't be able to access the temple.

nodes.speaker: Amanda
nodes.text: Anyway, good luck! I really need to get back to my history assignment.

nodes.speaker: Amanda
nodes.text: It turns out there are, like, all these countries I never knew existed.
As Amanda wanders off, Hanid Smythe lurches unsteadily to his feet...

nodes.speaker: Hanid Smythe
nodes.text: Come on... We should get... Going...
A few moments later, NColddSpud, KillerKitten13, and the rest of the Highpants Kings limp onto the Voidal Cast...
Their clothing is torn, their flesh scratched...

nodes.speaker: Elbow Baghands
nodes.text: One Dyre Bear I can handle. But thirteen?!

nodes.speaker: Elbow Baghands
nodes.text: We barely escaped with our lives!

nodes.speaker: Blue DaNoob
nodes.text: Yeah, NColddSpud. You definitely shouldn't have provoked Kobriak like that.

nodes.speaker: Elbow Baghands
nodes.text: We were lucky to get out alive!

nodes.speaker: NColddSpud
nodes.text: We got the directions, didn't we?!

nodes.speaker: Elbow Baghands
nodes.text: Yeah, but...

nodes.speaker: NColddSpud
nodes.text: Then why are you complaining?! Besides, who's the Clan Warchief here, me or you?!

nodes.speaker: Blue DaNoob
nodes.text: You, but...

nodes.speaker: NColddSpud
nodes.text: Exactly! Me!

nodes.speaker: KillerKitten13
nodes.text: Spuddykins, maybe we should log off for the night. We can try again tomorrow with a new strategy, and...

nodes.speaker: NColddSpud
nodes.text: No! No logging off! No quitting!

nodes.speaker: NColddSpud
nodes.text: I said we were going to get the PryBlade of Perfidius tonight, and that's exactly what we're going to do!

nodes.speaker: Elbow Baghands
nodes.text: Wow. I'm really starting to miss Brendizzle.

nodes.speaker: Blue DaNoob
nodes.text: Yeah. Me, too.

nodes.speaker: NColddSpud
nodes.text: Hey! I heard that!

nodes.speaker: Brendan
nodes.text: Oh no! My computer's lagging. I can't duck!
But before the Scorpiax Beetle can strike, Hanid Smythe leaps in front of Brendizzle. He is stung!

nodes.speaker: Hanid Smythe
nodes.text: Yowch!

nodes.speaker: Brendan
nodes.text: What?! No!
Amanda steps forward and...
Squishes the Scorpiax Beetle beneath her heel!

nodes.speaker: Brendizzle
nodes.text: Amanda, how did you do that?!

nodes.speaker: Amanda
nodes.text: I've been lost in here a `long` time! I'm level 140!
nodes.text_bbcode: I've been lost in here a [color=#3b78e2][i]long[/i][/color] time! I'm level 140!

nodes.text: Brendizzle and Hanid Smythe fight valiantly, but they are outnumbered by the vicious Scorpiax Beetles.

nodes.speaker: Brendizzle
nodes.text: There's too many of them! We need to retreat!

nodes.speaker: Amanda
nodes.text: Hey! What are you doing? Help me!
As Brendizzle and Hanid Smythe flee, a Scorpiax Beetle creeps up from behind.
The Scorpiax Beetle leaps at Brendizzle!
One loading screen later, on the Voidal Coast...

nodes.speaker: Brendizzle
nodes.text: Careful, Hanid Smythe, the Voidal Coast is frought with danger.

nodes.speaker: Hanid Smythe
nodes.text: Really? It doesn't seem so bad. Somebody even set up an umbrella and beach chair.

nodes.speaker: Brendizzle
nodes.text: No doubt left behind by hapless travelers, now deceased. These sands are littered with poisonous vermin.

nodes.speaker: Hanid Smythe
nodes.text: You mean like those?
Following the indication, Brendizzle spies a swarm of Scorpiax Beetles.
The Beetles surround a young woman.

nodes.speaker: Amanda
nodes.text: Eww! Icky!

nodes.speaker: Brendizzle
nodes.text: Wait... Amanda, is that you?

nodes.speaker: Amanda
nodes.text: Yes. Who are you?

nodes.speaker: Brendizzle
nodes.text: I'm Brendizz... I mean, Brendan. From school.

nodes.speaker: Amanda
nodes.text: Brendan? Really? Why do you look different?

nodes.speaker: Brendizzle
nodes.text: Because this is my avatar.

nodes.speaker: Amanda
nodes.text: Ava-what?

nodes.speaker: Brendizzle
nodes.text: This is the character I've chosen to represent myself in the virtual world of Warscrewdriver: Online.

nodes.speaker: Amanda
nodes.text: Uh...

nodes.speaker: Brendizzle
nodes.text: This is what I look like in the game you're playing right now.

nodes.speaker: Amanda
nodes.text: Game? I'm trying to do my history homework. When I clicked on the link to go to Wakkapedia, I ended up here.

nodes.speaker: Brendizzle
nodes.text: I'm not sure how that's even possible, Amanda. Are you sure you didn't...?

nodes.speaker: Amanda
nodes.text: This is supposed to be an article on the War of Eighteen Elves!

nodes.speaker: Brendan
nodes.text: The War of `Eighteen Elves...?`
nodes.text_bbcode: The War of [color=#e23b3b][i]Eighteen Elves...?[/i][/color]

nodes.speaker: Brendan
nodes.text: Hmm, I think I may have deduced the problem here.
Enraged by the commotion, the Scorpiax Beetles attack!

nodes.speaker: Brendizzle
nodes.text: Careful, Hanid Smythe. When these vermin sting, they inject a powerful poison!

nodes.speaker: Hanid Smythe
nodes.text: Then we'll need to work together...

nodes.speaker: Brendizzle
nodes.text: Attack!

nodes.speaker: Brendan
nodes.text: Scorpiax Beetles are deadly. This could be my toughest battle yet.

rounds.subtitle: Help Brendizzle fight! Attack to win!
Help Brendizzle fight! Attack to win!

nodes.text: In the Firebrand Inn...

nodes.speaker: Elbow Baghands
nodes.text: I'm telling you... It was incredible! NColddSpud was, like, 'I know the secret words.'

nodes.speaker: Blue DaNoob
nodes.text: But he was totally just posturing... Then Brendizzle walked out...

nodes.speaker: Elbow Baghands
nodes.text: And he was already carrying the PryBlade of Perfidius!

nodes.speaker: Blue DaNoob
nodes.text: I can't wait until he posts the screencaps of his adventures online! That quest must've been epic!
In the Trisfallion Mire...

nodes.speaker: Kobriak
nodes.text: Hmm, Brendizzle managed to get the PryBlade of Perfidius, did he?

nodes.speaker: Kobriak
nodes.text: Well, I trust a Warrior as righteous as he will use its power wisely.

nodes.speaker: Kobriak
nodes.text: Perhaps it's finally time to immortalize him in one of my riddles. Let's see...

nodes.speaker: Kobriak
nodes.text: How about, 'What's black and white and rhymes with 'sizzle'?'

nodes.speaker: Kobriak
nodes.text: No, that's not a very good riddle. Okay, how about... 'What do you call a gorilla with a banana in each ear?'

nodes.speaker: Kobriak
nodes.text: Grr... That's not even on topic! Let's see...
On the Voidal Coast...

nodes.speaker: Amanda
nodes.text: Um... Hello? If anyone can hear me, I'm done searching the Internet now, and I'd like to go home. Um... anyone?

nodes.speaker: Amanda
nodes.text: ...Anyone?
And on the cliffs overlooking Lake Doom...

nodes.speaker: Perfidius
nodes.text: Two men enter... One man leaves... Now fight!

nodes.speaker: NColddSpud
nodes.text: Wait a second... You mean, in order for one of us to get the PryBlade, we have to duel each other... To the `death?`
nodes.text_bbcode: Wait a second... You mean, in order for one of us to get the PryBlade, we have to duel each other... To the [color=#e23b3b][i]death?[/i][/color]

nodes.speaker: Perfidius
nodes.text: Them's the rules, dwarf. Take it or leave it.

nodes.speaker: NColddSpud
nodes.text: But that's not fair. I don't want to have to fight my girlfrie...

nodes.speaker: KillerKitten13
nodes.text: Nnyyyaahhhh!!!
KillerKitten13 tackles NColddSpud to the dirt.

nodes.speaker: NColddSpud
nodes.text: Cut it out, Kat! That really hurts! That... Hey! Put that sword down! IEEE!!!

nodes.speaker: Perfidius
nodes.text: Yes, excellent... Excellent!
And so ends our tour of `Warscrewdriver: Online.`
nodes.text_bbcode: And so ends our tour of [b]Warscrewdriver: Online.[/b]

nodes.text: Be sure to check back next week for another chance to prove your guile and cunning.

args.text: Thanks for playing! See you in another episode!

nodes.speaker: Brendan
nodes.text: You were trying to trick me!

nodes.speaker: Dinah
nodes.text: What?! No, I...

nodes.speaker: Brendan
nodes.text: First, you don't tell me about Kat and Spud kissing.

nodes.speaker: Brendan
nodes.text: Then, you conceal your identity from me on Warscrewdriver: Online.

nodes.speaker: Brendan
nodes.text: Well, I have news for you! Friendship is about being open and honest... Not lying to cover your tracks!

nodes.speaker: Dinah
nodes.text: But Brendan, that's not what I meant to do at all!

nodes.speaker: Dinah
nodes.text: I only wanted to hang out with you!

nodes.speaker: Brendan
nodes.text: And I'm supposed to believe you?

nodes.speaker: Brendan
nodes.text: Sorry! Not falling for it this time!

nodes.speaker: Brendan
nodes.text: See ya! Or better yet...

nodes.speaker: Brendan
nodes.text: ...How about I `don't!`
nodes.text_bbcode: ...How about I [color=#e23b3b][i]don't![/i][/color]

nodes.speaker: Dinah
nodes.text: Oh no! Sniff!

nodes.speaker: Dinah
nodes.text: I've ruined everything!
Wow! That could've gone a lot better! You did manage to acquire the legendary PryBlade of Perfidius...
But Brendan and Dinah still aren't talking.
If you play again, I'm sure you can find a way to patch things up.

args.text: Try again! We know you can get a better ending than that!

nodes.text: In fact, you were perfect!
For playing so well, you've earned another look at the vast digital world of `Warscrewdriver: Online!`
nodes.text_bbcode: For playing so well, you've earned another look at the vast digital world of [b]Warscrewdriver: Online![/b]

nodes.speaker: Elbow Baghands
nodes.text: Look! It's Brendizzle! And he's got the PryBlade of Perfidius!

nodes.speaker: NColddSpud
nodes.text: But... How...?

nodes.speaker: Elbow Baghands
nodes.text: Because Brendizzle is a real Warchief! He always made sure questing was fun!

nodes.speaker: Blue DaNoob
nodes.text: Brendizzle, we're sorry we ever doubted you. If you'd let us, we'd like to join your new Clan.

nodes.speaker: Elbow Baghands
nodes.text: And we'll be sure to bring all of our gold with us!

nodes.speaker: Brendizzle
nodes.text: Sounds good! And I really can't wait to test the PryBlade out on some unsuspecting noobs in Arena...

nodes.speaker: Brendizzle
nodes.text: But first, there's something I need to do...

nodes.speaker: Brendizzle
nodes.text: In the real world.
Later that night, as Dinah powers down her computer, the doorbell rings.

nodes.speaker: Dinah
nodes.text: Huh? I wonder who that could be?

nodes.speaker: Dinah
nodes.text: Brendan! What are you doing here?

nodes.speaker: Brendan
nodes.text: I wanted to tell you that I know.

nodes.speaker: Dinah
nodes.text: Know what?

nodes.speaker: Brendan
nodes.text: You don't have to pretend. You helped me on the quest to claim the PryBlade of Perfidius.

nodes.speaker: Dinah
nodes.text: How did you figure it out?

nodes.speaker: Brendan
nodes.text: 'Hanid' is just 'Dinah' spelled backwards, and Brobert Smythe is the lead singer of your favorite band, 'The Kure!'

nodes.speaker: Dinah
nodes.text: Hmm... I guess I should've made it harder to guess.

nodes.speaker: Dinah
nodes.text: You're not mad at me, are you?

nodes.speaker: Brendan
nodes.text: Dinah, I know things have been strained between us lately...

nodes.speaker: Brendan
nodes.text: But I want you to know that I understand why you didn't tell me about Spud and Kat.

nodes.speaker: Dinah
nodes.text: You do?

nodes.speaker: Brendan
nodes.text: Yes...

nodes.speaker: KillerKitten13
nodes.text: Spuddykins, open the gates already.

nodes.speaker: NColddSpud
nodes.text: I'm trying, wench. Just give me a minute to think.

nodes.speaker: Elbow Baghands
nodes.text: It's already been twenty minutes. You have no idea what you're doing, do you?

nodes.speaker: NColddSpud
nodes.text: Of course, I do! I'm the Clan Warchief, remember!

nodes.speaker: Elbow Baghands
nodes.text: Okay. Then what are the words you say to open the temple gates?

nodes.speaker: NColddSpud
nodes.text: I... I... Know what they are... The words are...

nodes.speaker: Brendizzle
nodes.text: Amicus Prodo!
Brendizzle crosses down the temple steps.
Meanwhile, NColddSpud, KillerKitten13, and the remaining members of the Highpants Kings stand at the temple gates.

nodes.speaker: NColddSpud
nodes.text: 'Amigo Protocol'... No... 'Amicable Poultry'... No...

nodes.speaker: Brendizzle
nodes.text: If you want the PryBlade, it's yours. I'm not going to fight you.

nodes.speaker: Hanid Smythe
nodes.text: Brendan, it's okay. You can have the stupid weapon.

nodes.speaker: Brendizzle
nodes.text: Uh... Wha... I can?!

nodes.speaker: Hanid Smythe
nodes.text: Of course, you can! This is what the whole quest was about!

nodes.speaker: Hanid Smythe
nodes.text: Last week, I heard Kat and Spud conspiring to take over your Clan.

nodes.speaker: Hanid Smythe
nodes.text: And then, this afternoon, I talked to Hector, and he told me what you were planning.

nodes.speaker: Hanid Smythe
nodes.text: I knew I had to intervene to make sure things turned out okay for you.

nodes.speaker: Brendan
nodes.text: So I do know you! I knew it! But... Who are you?

nodes.speaker: Hanid Smythe
nodes.text: Brendan, go ahead. Take the PryBlade.
Heeding the wishes of Hanid Smythe, Brendizzle wraps his fingers around the hilt of the PryBlade...

nodes.speaker: Perfidius
nodes.text: Yes!

nodes.speaker: Perfidius
nodes.text: By taking the PryBlade from the altar, you have accepted the terms of its acquisition! You will now fight each other!

nodes.speaker: Perfidius
nodes.text: No jury... No appeal... Two men enter, one man leaves! It'll be totally sweet!

nodes.speaker: Brendizzle
nodes.text: Look, I'm not sure I want to do this...

nodes.speaker: Hanid Smythe
nodes.text: You need the PryBlade to get your Clan to take you back as leader, right?

nodes.speaker: Brendizzle
nodes.text: Yeah, but...

nodes.speaker: Hanid Smythe
nodes.text: Well, what are friends for?
Before Brendizzle can react, Hanid Smythe casts 'immolate self' for 9,999 damage!

nodes.speaker: Brendan
nodes.text: What the...?!

nodes.speaker: Brendan
nodes.text: NoOOooOOooOOoo!!!

nodes.speaker: Perfidius
nodes.text: Humph! Not much of a fight, but the conditions have been met. You may now take the PryBlade.

nodes.speaker: Brendizzle
nodes.text: Hanid Smythe, I hereby vow that I will use this weapon with a dignity befitting your great sacrifice.

nodes.speaker: Kitten
nodes.text: Meow!

nodes.speaker: Brendizzle
nodes.text: And also I will take care of your orphaned kitten.

nodes.speaker: Kitten
nodes.text: Purrr...

nodes.speaker: Perfidius
nodes.text: Yes! Excellent! The conditions have been met. You may now take the PryBlade.

nodes.speaker: NColddSpud
nodes.text: Don't mind if I do!
Brendizzle looks back to the altar and finds NColddSpud holding the PryBlade.

nodes.speaker: Brendizzle
nodes.text: Hey, what are you doing? That's mine!

nodes.speaker: NColddSpud
nodes.text: Not anymore! This weapon is 'bind on pick up'. That means it belongs to me now!

nodes.speaker: NColddSpud
nodes.text: But it is funny you're here.

nodes.speaker: NColddSpud
nodes.text: When you're looking for treaure, I guess 'ex' really does mark the spot.

nodes.speaker: Elbow Baghands
nodes.text: Hey! Look! Spud has the PryBlade of Perfidius!

nodes.speaker: Blue DaNoob
nodes.text: Congratulations! We're sorry we ever doubted you!

nodes.speaker: KillerKitten13
nodes.text: Yay! Looks like my Spuddykins really is the best Warchief.
KillerKitten13 glares at Brendan.

nodes.speaker: KillerKitten13
nodes.text: Eww... What's 'old news' doing here?

nodes.speaker: NColddSpud
nodes.text: Oh, he was just leaving, weren't you?

nodes.speaker: Brendizzle
nodes.text: Yeah, I guess I was. I'll just log off now... And weep.

nodes.speaker: Brendan
nodes.text: Wow. I really thought playing Warscrewdriver: Online would cheer me up. But now I feel worse than ever!

nodes.speaker: Brendan
nodes.text: Oh well... I wonder who Hanid Smythe was. It was almost like he knew me.

nodes.speaker: Brendan
nodes.text: But that's impossible... Isn't it?
Meanwhile, across town...
Dinah logs off her Warscrewdriver: Online account...

nodes.speaker: Dinah
nodes.text: Wow! After everything I went through helping him out, Brendan totally turned on me!

nodes.speaker: Dinah
nodes.text: I guess maybe it's not so bad we aren't talking. Who needs a friend like that?!
Well, that could've gone a whole lot better!
Brendan didn't acquire the legendary PryBlade of Perfidius...
Spud is still Warchief of the Highpants Kings...
And now Dinah is having second thoughts about rekindling her friendship with Brendan!
There's only one thing to do. Play again and see if you can't repair some of the damage you've done!

args.text: Try again! We know you can get a better ending than that!

nodes.speaker: Brendizzle
nodes.text: Hanid Smythe, I... I haven't exactly been honest with you. When I planned this quest, I thought I'd be dueling against my ex-girlfriend.

nodes.speaker: Brendizzle
nodes.text: I was going to use the search for the PryBlade to get revenge on her for cheating on me.

nodes.speaker: Brendizzle
nodes.text: But that doesn't mean you should have to suffer for her mistakes... Or for mine.

nodes.speaker: Hanid Smythe
nodes.text: No! Brendizzle, what are you doing?! I thought we were friends!

nodes.speaker: Brendizzle
nodes.text: Friends? Ha! I only allowed you to travel with me this far because I needed someone to sacrifice.

nodes.speaker: Brendizzle
nodes.text: Besides, it's not like you're anyone I know.

nodes.speaker: Brendizzle
nodes.text: You're just some random person I met on the internet. Who cares what happens to you?

nodes.speaker: Hanid Smythe
nodes.text: No, I'm not some random person! I'm actually Din--
Brendan performs a massive multi-attack combo, triggers his 'ire' abilties, and then...
Brendizzle draws his sword!

nodes.speaker: Brendizzle
nodes.text: ...Then so be it! En guarde!

nodes.speaker: Brendizzle
nodes.text: Hanid Smythe, I'm sorry to do this to you, but being Warchief means everything to me.

nodes.speaker: Brendizzle
nodes.text: If we have to fight in order for me to get the PryBlade...
Later, on the cliffs overlooking Lake Doom...
Brendizzle and Hanid stand at the base of a sinister-looking temple.

nodes.character: Go on. Say the magic words.

nodes.speaker: Brendan
nodes.text: Okay, let's hope Amanda knew what she was talking about...
The temple gates open, revealing a shimmering blade perched on an ominous, grey altar!

nodes.speaker: Hanid Smythe
nodes.text: Is that...?

nodes.speaker: Brendizzle
nodes.text: The PryBlade of Perfidius! It's really real!
As Brendizzle steps toward the altar...
An evil sorcerer appears before him!

nodes.speaker: Perfidius
nodes.text: Hold, traveler! Be forewarned! Only one of you may claim the PryBlade!

nodes.speaker: Perfidius
nodes.text: Stay your hand now lest you be forced to do battle against each other.

nodes.speaker: Perfidius
nodes.text: But if you do choose to fight, know now that the stakes are dear.

nodes.speaker: Perfidius
nodes.text: The winner will claim the Legendary PryBlade of Perfidius. But the loser...

nodes.speaker: Perfidius
nodes.text: The loser will lose `everything!!!`
nodes.text_bbcode: The loser will lose [color=#e23b3b][i]everything!!![/i][/color]

nodes.text: The Spirit of Perfidius cackles maniacally!

nodes.speaker: Brendan
nodes.text: Oh no! This is happening exactly like the Warscrewdriver: Online Quest forums said it would.

nodes.speaker: Brendan
nodes.text: In order to acquire the PryBlade, I'm going to have to do battle against Hanid Smythe.

nodes.speaker: Brendan
nodes.text: What should I do? Should I...

nodes.speaker: Brendizzle
nodes.text: ...And then he even stole my quest idea!

nodes.speaker: Hanid Smythe
nodes.text: Wow... I can't believe NColddSpud would do that to you.

nodes.speaker: Brendizzle
nodes.text: Tell me about it!

nodes.speaker: Hanid Smythe
nodes.text: But it does give me an idea.

nodes.speaker: Hanid Smythe
nodes.text: If you were able to find the PryBlade of Perfidius before NColddSpud was able to get it...

nodes.speaker: Hanid Smythe
nodes.text: You'd prove, once and for all, that you're the better Warchief!

nodes.speaker: Brendizzle
nodes.text: You really think that would work?

nodes.speaker: Hanid Smythe
nodes.text: Sure! When Izzy Izdead got kicked out of The Stygian Sundaes, he went solo and won the Grundy for 'Best Goth Rock Album'.

nodes.speaker: Hanid Smythe
nodes.text: After that, The Stygian Sundaes were begging him to come back.

nodes.speaker: Brendan
nodes.text: The Stygian Sundaes? I know I heard somebody talking about that band at school.

nodes.speaker: Brendan
nodes.text: But who...?

nodes.speaker: Brendizzle
nodes.text: You may be right, Hanid Smythe, but it doesn't make a difference.

nodes.speaker: Hanid Smythe
nodes.text: Why not?

nodes.speaker: Brendizzle
nodes.text: Because the quest requires at least two people to complete. I can't do it by myself.

nodes.speaker: Hanid Smythe
nodes.text: Who said you'd be doing it by yourself?

nodes.speaker: Brendizzle
nodes.text: You mean... You'd want to help me?

nodes.speaker: Hanid Smythe
nodes.text: You're the great Warchief Brendizzle. It would be an honor to share your quest!

nodes.speaker: Brendan
nodes.text: Hmm. Either Hanid Smythe doesn't know about the curse on the PryBlade of Perfidius...

nodes.speaker: Brendan
nodes.text: Or he's planning to stab me in the back once we find it!

nodes.speaker: Brendan
nodes.text: Then again, it's not like I have a lot of options.

nodes.speaker: Brendan
nodes.text: And getting the PryBlade before Spud would really prove to everyone that I'm the better Warchief...

nodes.speaker: Hanid Smythe
nodes.text: Well, are we going after the PryBlade or not?

nodes.speaker: Brendizzle
nodes.text: Okay... Let's do it.
One loading screen later, in the Trisfallion Mire...

nodes.speaker: Brendizzle
nodes.text: Okay. This is the place, the Cavern of Kobriak the Outlier.

nodes.speaker: Hanid Smythe
nodes.text: Outlier...? I thought we were looking for the PryBlade.

nodes.speaker: Brendizzle
nodes.text: We are. But this is a multi-part quest.

nodes.speaker: Brendizzle
nodes.text: First, we have to find Kobriak the Outlier. He's the only one who knows where the PryBlade is hidden.

nodes.speaker: Brendizzle
nodes.text: Once Kobriak tells us what he knows, then we can go find the PryBlade itself.

nodes.speaker: Hanid Smythe
nodes.text: Okay... But why does he live all the way out here?

nodes.speaker: Brendizzle
nodes.text: Because people with important information about mystical weapons always live in dangerous places far removed from civilization.

nodes.speaker: Hanid Smythe
nodes.text: But why?

nodes.speaker: NColddSpud
nodes.text: Ha! At long last! Kobriak the Outlier!

nodes.speaker: Kobriak
nodes.text: Hrm?
Looking back, Kobriak the Outlier discovers he is surrounded by NColddSpud, KillerKitten13, and the rest of the Highpants Kings.

nodes.speaker: NColddSpud
nodes.text: You're him, aren't you?

nodes.speaker: NColddSpud
nodes.text: Gallivax the Mutterer told us you know where the legendary PryBlade of Perfidius is.

nodes.speaker: Kobriak
nodes.text: Indeed. I am burdened with that knowledge.

nodes.speaker: NColddSpud
nodes.text: Great! Now tell us where it is or else!
Kobriak the Outlier rears back to reveal his massive sinewy frame; he unleashes a mighty, guttural roar!

nodes.speaker: Kobriak
nodes.text: Or else what, dwarf?!

nodes.speaker: NColddSpud
nodes.text: Or else, well... We'll... Um... Gulp!

nodes.speaker: Kobriak
nodes.text: ROOOOOAAAAARRR!!!

nodes.speaker: Brendan
nodes.text: Hanid Smythe, you've just been pwned, noob!!!

nodes.speaker: Brendizzle
nodes.text: Barmaid, a flagon of fermented yak's milk to ease my troubled mind.

nodes.speaker: Barmaid
nodes.text: Certainly.

nodes.speaker: Barmaid
nodes.text: That'll be five silver, if you please.

nodes.speaker: Brendizzle
nodes.text: Five silver? That's no problem, I'll just...

nodes.speaker: Brendan
nodes.text: Oh no! I just realized that without access to the Clan Treasury, I'm completely broke!

nodes.speaker: Brendan
nodes.text: I don't have any money to pay for this drink!

nodes.speaker: Brendizzle
nodes.text: Uh... So Barmaid, I appear to have left my wallet in my other pair of greaves.

nodes.speaker: Barmaid
nodes.text: What's that? Not paying?!

nodes.speaker: Brendizzle
nodes.text: No, I'll pay! I mean, I would pay, but...

nodes.speaker: Barmaid
nodes.text: Security!!!

nodes.speaker: Paladin Monte
nodes.text: What do we have here? A deadbeat?! We have methods for dealing with the likes of you!

nodes.speaker: Paladin Monte
nodes.text: And those methods involve dungeons, torture, and R.O.S.E.S.!

nodes.speaker: Brendizzle
nodes.text: Roses? Why? Because they have sharp thorns and attract venomous snake-bees?

nodes.speaker: Paladin Monte
nodes.text: No! R.O.S.E.S.! It's an acronym. It stands for `Rodents of Super-Extraordinary Size!`
nodes.text_bbcode: No! R.O.S.E.S.! It's an acronym. It stands for [color=#e23b3b][i]Rodents of Super-Extraordinary Size![/i][/color]

nodes.speaker: Paladin Monte
nodes.text: They're way bigger and meaner than the 'unusually-sized' rodents you may have seen elsewhere.

nodes.speaker: Brendizzle
nodes.text: Gulp!

An elven mage named `Hanid Smythe` offers you a gift of five silver.

nodes.speaker: Hanid Smythe
nodes.text: Here. Take this.

nodes.speaker: Kitten
nodes.text: Meow!

nodes.text: `Hanid Smythe?`

nodes.speaker: Brendan
nodes.text: The name sounds kind of familiar. Do I know anybody who has an avatar with that name?

nodes.speaker: Brendizzle
nodes.text: So, do I know you? Are you a re-roll of someone I've played with before?

nodes.speaker: Hanid Smythe
nodes.text: All your questions will be answered in time, Brendizzle. First, you must accept this gift of five silver and pay your tab.

nodes.speaker: Brendan
nodes.text: Hmm. I'm in a bit of a jam here, but I really don't like taking money from strangers. I should...

nodes.speaker: Brendizzle
nodes.text: Careful, Hanid Smythe, the Voidal Coast is frought with danger.

nodes.speaker: Hanid Smythe
nodes.text: Really? It doesn't seem so bad. Somebody even set up an umbrella and beach chair.

nodes.speaker: Brendizzle
nodes.text: No doubt left behind by hapless travelers, now deceased. These sands are littered with poisonous vermin.

nodes.speaker: Hanid Smythe
nodes.text: You mean like those?
Following the indication, Brendizzle spies a swarm of Scorpiax Beetles.
The Beetles surround a young woman.

nodes.speaker: Amanda
nodes.text: Eww! Icky!

nodes.speaker: Brendizzle
nodes.text: Wait... Amanda, is that you?

nodes.speaker: Amanda
nodes.text: Yes. Who are you?

nodes.speaker: Brendizzle
nodes.text: I'm Brendizz... I mean, Brendan. From school.

nodes.speaker: Amanda
nodes.text: Brendan? Really? Why do you look different?

nodes.speaker: Brendizzle
nodes.text: Because this is my avatar.

nodes.speaker: Amanda
nodes.text: Ava-what?

nodes.speaker: Brendizzle
nodes.text: This is the character I've chosen to represent myself in the virtual world of Warscrewdriver: Online.

nodes.speaker: Amanda
nodes.text: Uh...

nodes.speaker: Brendizzle
nodes.text: This is what I look like in the game you're playing right now.

nodes.speaker: Amanda
nodes.text: Game? I'm trying to do my history homework. When I clicked on the link to go to Wakkapedia, I ended up here.

nodes.speaker: Brendizzle
nodes.text: I'm not sure how that's even possible, Amanda. Are you sure you didn't...?

nodes.speaker: Amanda
nodes.text: This is supposed to be an article on the War of Eighteen Elves!

nodes.speaker: Brendan
nodes.text: The War of `Eighteen Elves...?`
nodes.text_bbcode: The War of [color=#e23b3b][i]Eighteen Elves...?[/i][/color]

nodes.speaker: Brendan
nodes.text: Hmm, I think I may have deduced the problem here.
Enraged by the commotion, the Scorpiax Beetles attack!

nodes.speaker: Brendizzle
nodes.text: Careful, Hanid Smythe. When these vermin sting, they inject a powerful poison!

nodes.speaker: Hanid Smythe
nodes.text: Then we'll need to work together...

nodes.speaker: Brendizzle
nodes.text: Attack!

nodes.speaker: Brendan
nodes.text: Scorpiax Beetles are deadly. This could be my toughest battle yet.

nodes.text: Hanid Smythe, I... I haven't exactly been honest with you. When I planned this quest, I thought I'd be dueling against my ex-girlfriend.

nodes.speaker: Brendizzle
nodes.text: I was going to use the search for the PryBlade to get revenge on her for cheating on me.

nodes.speaker: Brendizzle
nodes.text: But that doesn't mean you should have to suffer for her mistakes... Or for mine.
In fact, you were perfect!
For playing so well, you've earned another look at the vast digital world of `Warscrewdriver: Online!`

nodes.text: As the school day concludes, Brendan angrily stuffs textbooks into his backpack.

nodes.speaker: Dinah
nodes.text: Brendan, hey!

nodes.speaker: Brendan
nodes.text: Oh, Dinah, it's you. What do you want?

nodes.speaker: Dinah
nodes.text: Nothing... It's just that it's been a few weeks since we last spoke, and... Well, I was hoping we could start hanging out again.

nodes.speaker: Brendan
nodes.text: Dinah, you knew Kat cheated on me and you didn't tell me.

nodes.speaker: Dinah
nodes.text: I know, Brendan, but...

nodes.speaker: Brendan
nodes.text: I thought you were my friend!

nodes.speaker: Dinah
nodes.text: Brendan, I am your friend! I'd do anything for you!

nodes.speaker: Brendan
nodes.text: That's what you say...

nodes.speaker: Brendan
nodes.text: But I think you proved otherwise.

nodes.speaker: Dinah
nodes.text: Wow. Brendan is still really mad at me.

nodes.speaker: Dinah
nodes.text: I want to prove I'm his friend, but how can I when he keeps pushing me away?
A few minutes later, Hector spies Brendan rushing through the parking lot.

nodes.speaker: Hector
nodes.text: Yo, Brendan! Where are you going in such a hurry?

nodes.speaker: Brendan
nodes.text: Home, actually. I...

nodes.speaker: Hector
nodes.text: Home?! Seriously?

nodes.speaker: Brendan
nodes.text: Is that a problem?

nodes.speaker: Hector
nodes.text: Yeah, it's a problem! Brendan, we haven't hung out together in weeks!

nodes.speaker: Hector
nodes.text: You've been holed up in your room ever since you found out that Kat kissed Spud.

nodes.speaker: Hector
nodes.text: Brendan, believe me. I understand what you're going through.

nodes.speaker: Hector
nodes.text: When Porscha dumped me last summer, I sulked for, like, two days solid. I thought I'd never make out with a girl ever again.

nodes.speaker: Hector
nodes.text: But what I finally realized is this... There are other fish in the sea.

nodes.speaker: Hector
nodes.text: And you aren't gonna smooch any of them if you're not willing to step up to the plate and shoot for the stars. You feel me?

nodes.speaker: Brendan
nodes.text: Yeah... Hector, that made sense. Sort of.

nodes.speaker: Hector
nodes.text: Great! Then climb into my Love Wagon, and we'll make like bees. By, which I mean, we'll buzz around and find us some honeys!

nodes.speaker: Brendan
nodes.text: First off, bees don't find honey. They regurgitate it. And, second...

nodes.speaker: Brendan
nodes.text: Tonight, I'm holing up in my room for reasons completely unrelated to my abject despair.

nodes.speaker: Hector
nodes.text: And those reasons would be...?

nodes.speaker: Brendan
nodes.text: I'm playing `Warscrewdriver: Online.`
nodes.text_bbcode: I'm playing [color=#e23b3b][i]Warscrewdriver: Online.[/i][/color]

nodes.speaker: Hector
nodes.text: You mean that massively multiplying ornery... Uh... MMO... You mean that computer game you're into, right?

nodes.speaker: Brendan
nodes.text: It's an MMORPG. A Massively Multi-player Online Role Playing Game.

nodes.speaker: Brendan
nodes.text: I haven't logged on in a few weeks, but tonight, I'm leading my clan, the `Highpants Kings`, on a raiding party to claim the legendary `PryBlade of Perfidius.`

nodes.speaker: Hector
nodes.text: But wait... Isn't Kat in the same clan as you? Do you really want to be spending all that time with your ex?

nodes.speaker: Brendan
nodes.text: But that's the best part!

nodes.speaker: Hector
nodes.text: It is? Why? I thought you'd be trying everything you could to avoid her.

nodes.speaker: Brendan
nodes.text: It isn't common knowledge but, according to my research on the Warscrewdriver: Online Quest Forums...

nodes.text: The PryBlade of Perfidius is saddled with a terrible curse.

nodes.speaker: Brendan
nodes.text: The evil spirit guarding the treasure compels any pair who seeks it to fight each other for the right to claim the prize.

nodes.speaker: Brendan
nodes.text: Whoever wins gets the weapon, and whoever loses gets drop-kicked back to Level One with zero experience and no gold!

nodes.speaker: Brendan
nodes.text: I figure this quest will be a great way for me and Kat to hammer out our differences.

nodes.speaker: Brendan
nodes.text: But instead of a hammer, I plan to use an epic two-handed mace!

nodes.text: So this is all about revenge?

nodes.speaker: Brendizzle
nodes.text: Friends? Ha! I only allowed you to travel with me this far because I needed someone to sacrifice.

nodes.text: Yes! Excellent! The conditions have been met. You may now take the PryBlade.

nodes.speaker: Brendan
nodes.text: Yes! I rule! Now to show everyone how totally 1337 a Clan Warchief I am!

nodes.text: Warrior, before you go. I must ask you one question.

nodes.speaker: Perfidius
nodes.text: Did you happen to have any plans for that kitten you just orphaned?

nodes.speaker: Perfidius
nodes.text: I only ask because it's getting kind of late, and I'd rather not have to stop by the grocery store on the way home.

nodes.text: Meow?

nodes.text: Sure. Whatever. Not my kitten.

nodes.speaker: Brendan
nodes.text: You were trying to protect me.

nodes.speaker: Brendan
nodes.text: And I'm sorry for overreacting the way I did. I really hope we can still be friends.

nodes.text: Of course, we can still be friends! I spent the last three weeks leveling up 'Hanid Smythe' just so I could spend time with you!

nodes.speaker: Brendan
nodes.text: Really?

nodes.text: Well, then it looks like we'll be spending lots of time together.

nodes.text: We will?

nodes.text: You'd do that for me?
